name: dev-workflow
description: Structured, multi-step development workflow: clarify → plan → implement → test → review → document → release, with an optional TDD (red → green → refactor) path. Each step is a /workflow-* skill you invoke explicitly, except branch creation which can also be offered automatically; steps share state via .workflow/current-issue.md in the working project.

autoOpen.title: Auto-open workflow panel
autoOpen.description: Open the workflow panel on the first /workflow-* skill of a session

modelSwitch.title: Switch model by skill
modelSwitch.description: Keep the session on a skill's frontmatter model after its first turn: off, suggest (asks before switching), upgrade (never to a smaller model), multi-turn (skills marked multi-turn), or always. A switch also saves the model as your default; the next session puts your default back

showSwitchCost.title: Show model switch cost
showSwitchCost.description: On every model switch, show what it costs in prompt cache: first an upper-bound estimate, then the tokens and cost measured from the next response. The workflow panel keeps a session total

spendReport.title: Show model spend
spendReport.description: Keep a ledger of what the session spends and show it in the workflow panel: total (spend and what model switches cost of it), model (plus tokens and dollars per model), step (plus the same per workflow step)
